```artifact
Feature: System Access and Functionality for U17_5

  Scenario: System is available only on Specified PinCodes
    Given the Parameter Control File contains PinCodes Z1, Z2, and Z3
    When a user tries to access the system from PinCode Z1
    Then the system should allow access
    And when a user tries to access the system from PinCode Z4
    Then the system should deny access

  Scenario Outline: User can log in with a login-id and password
    Given the system has a user with login-id "<login-id>" and password "<password>"
    When the user attempts to log in with login-id "<login-id>" and password "<password>"
    Then the system should <result> access

    Examples:
      | login-id | password | result |
      | user1    | pass1    | allow  |
      | user2    | wrong    | deny   |
      | user3    |          | deny   |

  Scenario: Login-id/password is managed in a secured manner
    Given the system has a user with login-id "user1" and password "pass1"
    When the user attempts to log in with login-id "user1" and password "pass1"
    Then the system should log the login attempt securely

  Scenario: Each Speciality has one or more Doctors linked to it
    Given the system has a Speciality "Cardiology"
    When the system is queried for Doctors linked to Speciality "Cardiology"
    Then the system should return a list of Doctors ["Doctor1", "Doctor2"]

  Scenario: Each Doctor is mapped to ONE and ONLY ONE Speciality
    Given the system has a Doctor "Doctor1"
    When the system is queried for the Speciality of Doctor "Doctor1"
    Then the system should return "Cardiology"

  Scenario: Each Doctor provides Consultation to ONE or More Patients
    Given the system has a Doctor "Doctor1"
    When the system is queried for Patients consulted by Doctor "Doctor1"
    Then the system should return a list of Patients ["Patient1", "Patient2"]

  Scenario: Each Patient has to register by filling Patient profile
    Given a Patient with details "Name: John Doe, Age: 30, Gender: Male"
    When the Patient registers in the system
    Then the system should generate a unique id for the Patient

  Scenario Outline: Each Patient can request for one or more consultation Requests
    Given the system has a Patient with unique id "<patient-id>"
    When the Patient requests a consultation for Speciality "<speciality>"
    Then the system should create a consultation request linked to Speciality "<speciality>"

    Examples:
      | patient-id | speciality   |
      | P001       | Cardiology   |
      | P002       | Dermatology  |
```
